_comment: features/api/trading/trade_fixings.feature. API-001 refreshes the online fixings of a submitted trade, then compares the retrieved trade with its recording and checks its fixings against the schedule. The recording holds each observable of data.fixings as any array (the number of fixings grows as dates pass); the step 'every schedule date before today has a fixing value' checks the dates and values. checkData.fixingDates: the response paths of the trade's fixing dates, product knowledge. A product whose dates are all in the future has data.fixings {}: its byProduct gives "dynamicFields": { "data.fixings.*": null }

FX_FSB._comment: Fixings on the reset dates (the Reset column of the schedule)

FX_TRF._comment: No tradeDetailsSchedule: the reset dates of the instrument's schedule
